Running shoes fitted to the way you run

Acme Running is a small shop for people who run on roads, trails and tracks. Every pair we sell starts with a short gait check on our treadmill, so we can see how your foot lands, how far it rolls inward, and how your knees track over each stride. We then bring out three or four shoes that suit that pattern and let you run in each one for a few minutes. Most runners leave with a shoe they had never heard of before they walked in.

Trail shoes

Our trail range covers short muddy loops, long rocky mountain days and everything between. We stock shoes with deep lugs for soft ground, firmer plates for sharp stones, and wider bases for runners who want more stability on uneven paths. Staff test each model on the local hills before it reaches the shelf, and we write down what we learn so you can read it before your fitting.

Road shoes

For the road we carry daily trainers, light racing shoes and cushioned pairs for recovery runs. If you are training for your first half marathon we can help you pick one shoe for long runs and one for faster sessions. Bring your old shoes along: the wear on the soles tells us a lot about where you need support and where you do not.

Returns and care

You can return any pair within sixty days, even after running in it, as long as it is clean. We also resole selected trail models and recycle worn shoes through a local program that turns old foam into playground surfaces for schools in our town.
